description: Erection of side and rear extensions to lower ground floor, ground floor and first floor flats. Erection of a rear roof extension with a hip to gable conversion and a front roof window to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building (rendered walls for the three-storey side and wrap-around extensions; roof tiles for the rear dormer, hip-to-gable and roof to the side extension).

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (A01(P4), A02(P5), A03(P3) and A04(P4) [received 13/09/2019], and E01(P1), E02(P1), E03(P1), Location Plan and Design and Access Statement [received 14/06/2019]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Prior to the completion of hereby approved extensions, full details (including manufacturers specifications) of secure covered cycle parking facilities (for not less than two bicycles per unit) and access to them for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved facilities shall conform to current guidance such as the TfL London Cycling Design Standards in design and layout and be fully implemented and be made available within 3 months of approval and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.
